newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks flat in early trade ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks flat in early trade ahead of data.

text.p: Tokyo stocks stayed flat in early Friday morning trade as investors hunkered down on the sidelines to wait for industrial output data due to be released early in the afternoon, brokers said.
After 14 minutes of trade, the Nikkei 225 was up 17.90 points or 0.09 percent at 20,642.66. Its September futures were flat at 20,700.
"Investment trusts are scheduled to be launched and turnover has been heavy recently, so the downside will be limited," said Toyo Securities general manager Katsuhiko Kodama.
"But the the topside is heavy and indices may not rise."
